title: A product with an owner
sub: Planning's census count was late, and nobody answered for it. The eighth film of a series on data governance: data as a product, with a promise, and an owner who keeps it.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms, and opens in Istanbul, at the market round the bedesten. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions; green runs in the work.
